description: This file defines the Legend class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Chart namespace. It provides functionality to manage chart legend properties such as position, layout, overlay, border lines, and fill color.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Represents a chart legend with configurable position, layout, overlay, border lines, and fill color within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Legend object with optional position, layout, and overlay settings.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color object of the legend.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the current legend position as an Excel string value.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the legend position using an Excel string value.

methods.name: getPositionXL
methods.description: Returns the internal numeric value representing the legend position.

methods.name: setPositionXL
methods.description: Sets the legend position using an internal numeric value.

methods.name: getOverlay
methods.description: Checks if overlay of other elements is allowed.

methods.name: setOverlay
methods.description: Sets whether overlay of other elements is permitted.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout object associated with the legend.

methods.name: getLegendText
methods.description: Retrieves the legend's axis text description.

methods.name: setLegendText
methods.description: Sets the axis text for the legend.

methods.name: getBorderLines
methods.description: Returns the border lines object for the legend.

methods.name: setBorderLines
methods.description: Sets the border lines object for the legend.
